name: base_s1_lr0p5
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm

jobs.name: base_s1_lr0p5
jobs.cmd: for n in base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5 base_S_wd1p0_lr0p5 base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5 base_S_wd0p1_lr0p5 base_S_wd0_lr0p5; do python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_s1.json --only $n --device cuda || echo "[s1] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[s1] score $n failed"; }; done; ls babylm/runs/*/score/score.json
